assay: bulk RNA-seq (poly(A), NovaSeq 6000, STAR + featureCounts) of mouse heart
primary_estimand: Effect of doxorubicin vs vehicle, and of NMN on top of doxorubicin, on heart gene expression (acute regimen, D5). No exercise intervention: the only exercise-related measure is a treadmill exhaustion TEST (S2.5.p1, S3.7.p1) used as a phenotypic outcome in chronic cohort-2; RNA-seq hearts come from acute cohort-1 and chronic cohort-3 (S2.2.p2, S2.2.p4).
sample_inclusion: Acute: 13-14 hearts per group of cohort-1 (S2.2.p2)
planned_contrasts: Acute Doxo vs Ctrl (S3.3.p1; paper: 3874 DEGs)
Acute Doxo-NMN vs Doxo (S3.3.p1; paper: 2207 DEGs)
paper_method: edgeR 3.32.1, TMM, estimateDisp, glmQLFit + QL F-test (S2.9.p1)
